custom_event.secondary_draft.title: KBO Secondary Draft
custom_event.secondary_draft.window.body:
The {season} KBO secondary draft schedule has been set. Front offices can manage protection lists from {protection_open_date} through {protection_deadline_date}, with selections scheduled for {draft_date}.

Each club may protect {protected_limit} players. The draft runs for {round_count} rounds, and the final {extra_rounds} rounds are reserved for the lower {extra_teams} clubs to support competitive balance. Once protection lists close, attention shifts to the exposed-player pool and draft order.
